messages.content: 在一場撲克遊戲中，確定贏家是誰，約翰手中有8♥、10♥、J♥、Q♥、K♥，邁克手中有9♠、J♠、10♠、Q♠、K♠。

function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hand1.description: The list of cards (as strings) in first player's hand. E.g ['10♠', 'J♠']

hand2.description: The list of cards (as strings) in second player's hand. E.g ['9♥', '10♥']

message.content: 邁克贏了。邁克的手牌 9♠、10♠、J♠、Q♠、K♠ 形成了「順子同花」（Straight Flush），而約翰的手牌 8♥、10♥、J♥、Q♥、K♥ 只是一副同花（Flush）。順子同花比同花高，故邁克勝出。
message.reasoning: We need to determine winner. John has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's a straight flush? Actually 8-10-J-Q-K hearts: that's a straight flush (8-10-J-Q-K). Mike has 9♠,J♠,10♠,Q♠,K♠: that's also a straight flush 9-10-J-Q-K. Which is higher? Straight flush with higher top card wins. John's top card K hearts, Mike's top card K spades. Both same rank K. But compare the next highest? Actually both have same sequence: 9-10-J-Q-K vs 8-10-J-Q-K. Wait John's sequence: 8,10,J,Q,K. That's not consecutive: 8-9-10-J-Q-K? Actually 8-10 missing 9. So it's not a straight flush. It's a flush with high cards: K, Q, J, 10, 8. That's a flush. Mike has 9,10,J,Q,K: that's a straight flush? 9-10-J-Q-K is consecutive. So Mike has a straight flush, which beats a flush. So Mike wins. So answer: Mike wins.
